product_one_liner.value: Typeface is an agentic AI platform for enterprise marketing teams that orchestrates brand intelligence, content creation, and campaign workflows to produce personalized, on-brand campaigns at scale.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public pricing page was found; the site directs buyers to a sales demo and custom packages.

employee_band.notes: Reported headcount is 301 as of June 2026; the band is not an exact November headcount.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is predominantly marketing and product announcements. Posts by engineering/R&D leaders describe product capabilities and integrations, rather than providing two qualifying accounts of internal engineering implementation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live postings include Senior ML Engineer and Staff ML Engineer.

model_provider.value: Google (Gemini, Imagen and Veo); OpenAI and Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service.

compliance_certs.notes: Limited to the certification families requested.

last_funding.notes: The company announcement establishes a $100 million Series B in June 2023, but later funding records conflict: PitchBook and CB Insights list a September 2025 venture round without a public amount, while Indexed.vc reports an October 2025 $100 million Series C. No primary announcement or filing was found to resolve the latest round, so it is not safe to identify the 2023 round as the most recent.

raised_18mo.notes: The window is 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09. Databases report later 2025 funding, but no corroborating dated company announcement or filing was located; a false answer based only on the 2023 announcement would disregard those later records.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Enterprise Account Executive postings include East and West territories.

launched_6mo.notes: September 22, 2026: announced the next generation of its Orchestration Engine, connecting Arc Graph, Arc Fabric and Arc Loop; inside the 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Satya Krishnaswamy announced joining as Chief Customer Officer on November 10, 2025, inside the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly named integrations/customer-ecosystem systems, not verified internal subscriptions.
